_doc: Adjudicated digest items (task 4.6). A record's finding matches an entry when app matches and, if given, shape and msg_contains match. 'before' limits an entry to runs started before that time and 'after' to runs started at or after it: use it for harness bugs that were fixed, so a recurrence comes back as new. Matched findings are listed under 'Triaged' instead of 'Needs a look'. Entries without @host match the L0 confirm results by slug. App '*' matches every soak record (app@host); use it only with an after/before window.
